name: CAT/DE Pairs Mean-Reversion Strategy
description: Pairs mean-reversion strategy trading CAT vs DE (Caterpillar vs Deere). Computes the CAT/DE price ratio daily, then a 60-day rolling z-score. Entry: short CAT when z-score crosses above +2 (ratio overbought), long CAT when z-score crosses below -2 (ratio oversold). Exit: z-score reverts to 0 (mean reversion achieved) or extends beyond ±3 (stop loss). Dollar-neutral sizing at 50% per leg.
source:
# CAT/DE Pairs Mean-Reversion Strategy
# ======================================
# Signal: 60-day rolling z-score of the CAT/DE price ratio
# Long CAT when z < -2 (ratio oversold), Short CAT when z > +2 (ratio overbought)
# Exit when z reverts to 0, or capitulation stop at ±3
# Dollar-neutral: 50% allocation per leg (CAT is the traded leg)

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()
cat_close = src.c

# DE as reference stock
de_ref = reference_stocks(ticker="DE")()
de_close = de_ref.c

# --- Price Ratio & Z-Score ---
# CAT/DE price ratio
price_ratio = cat_close / de_close

# 60-day rolling z-score of the ratio
z = zscore(window=60)(price_ratio)

# --- Entry Signals (pulses) ---
# Z crosses above +2: ratio is overbought → SHORT CAT (expect ratio to fall)
enter_short_pulse = crossover(z, 2)

# Z crosses below -2: ratio is oversold → LONG CAT (expect ratio to rise)
enter_long_pulse = crossunder(z, -2)

# --- Exit Signals ---
# Exit long: z-score crosses back up through 0 (mean reversion) OR z drops below -3 (capitulation)
exit_long = crossover(z, 0) or z < -3

# Exit short: z-score crosses back down through 0 (mean reversion) OR z rises above +3 (capitulation)
exit_short = crossunder(z, 0) or z > 3

# --- Hold State ---
# Persist entry signals until exit conditions fire
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long_pulse, exit=exit_long)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=enter_short_pulse, exit=exit_short)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# 50% allocation = one leg of dollar-neutral pair
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=50)
